Itemized Passive Description:
*Basic effect(s)*
- ATK & DEF 200%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Changes Ki Spheres: PHY to Rainbow
- High chance of evading enemy's attack
- "Movie Heroes" or "Hybrid Saiyans" Category allies' Ki +2,
ATK 60%{passiveImg:up_g} and DEF 40%{passiveImg:up_g}
*For every Rainbow Ki Sphere obtained*
- ATK & DEF 50%{passiveImg:up_g} (up to 150%)
- Chance of performing a critical hit 10%{passiveImg:up_g} (up to 30%)
- Chance of evading enemy's attack 5%{passiveImg:up_g} (up to 15%)
*When there is another "Movie Heroes" or "Hybrid Saiyans"
Category ally attacking in the same turn*
- Launches an additional Super Attack
- ATK & DEF 50%{passiveImg:up_g} (up to 150%), chance of performing a
critical hit 10%{passiveImg:up_g} (up to 30%) and chance of evading enemy's
attack 5%{passiveImg:up_g} (up to 15%) per Rainbow Ki Sphere obtained
*When attacking with 12 or more Ki*
- ATK & DEF 200%{passiveImg:up_g}
- DEF 200%{passiveImg:up_g} with 1 or more Rainbow Ki Spheres obtained
- ATK 200%{passiveImg:up_g} with 2 or more Rainbow Ki Spheres obtained
*When there is an Extreme Class enemy*
- Randomly changes Ki Spheres of a certain Type (INT & PHY
excluded) to Rainbow Ki Spheres
